paper_id: Anti-diabetic effect of anthocyanin cyanidin-3-O-glucoside_ data from insulin resistant hepatocyte and diabetic mouse
title: Anti-diabetic effect of anthocyanin cyanidin-3-O-glucoside: data from insulin resistant hepatocyte and diabetic mouse
motivation: 化学药物有副作用,天然产物因来源广、无毒优势受到关注,需验证C3G缓解IR的机制
problem_framing: IR导致的葡萄糖代谢紊乱是T2DM核心,通过增强胰岛素敏感性改善
key_insight: C3G通过抑制PTP1B解除对IRS-2磷酸化的阻断,恢复胰岛素信号传导
method_signature: HepG2/L02细胞IR模型+db/db小鼠6周干预,Western blot/qRT-PCR
evaluation_criteria: 葡萄糖消耗/摄取、糖原合成、胰岛素敏感指数、PTP1B/p-IRS-2表达
negative_result_or_admitted_limitation: OGTT缺少C57BL/6J对照,无法量化db/db小鼠IR程度;仅OGTT和HOMA-IR不能构成对IR改善的稳健论证
evidence_for_taste: two distinct liver cell lines, HepG2 and L02, were used to eliminate cell line-specific variations
these results alone do not constitute a robust demonstration
acknowledged that these results alone do not constitute a robust demonstration
thinking_moves: 针对PTP1B负调控胰岛素信号的已知机制提出抑制假设
用两种肝细胞系排除细胞系特异性变异
从体外剂量依赖效应推导体内剂量选择
承认单一指标不能充分证明IR改善,需补充 clamp 实验
